cases.situation: My mother-in-law keeps telling me at every family dinner that I should quit my job and stay home with the baby. I'm going back to work in January and it's decided. I like her otherwise.
cases.reply: I know you ask because you love her, and I really appreciate how much you've helped these first months. We've made our decision about January and it's working for us. If I'm ever wrestling with it, you'll be one of the first people I ask.
cases.note: Respond to the love, not the clothes. If it comes up again, repeat the same short line rather than adding reasons.

cases.situation: 每次过年回家，我姑都要当着一桌亲戚说我30岁了还不结婚，让我赶紧找个人。我不想吵，也不想解释。
cases.reply: 姑，谢谢您惦记着我。这事我心里有数，您就放心吧。对了，表弟今年高考考得怎么样？
cases.note: 阶梯里最低的一档就够了：接住好意、不解释，然后换个话题。她再说，就重复同一句。

cases.situation: A coworker saw me eating a sandwich and started telling me all about his keto diet and how bread is 'basically poison'. Second time this week. We sit near each other.
cases.reply: You've mentioned this a couple of times, Nate. I've heard it and I'm happy with what I eat, so let's give food a rest. How did the demo with Brightwell go?
cases.note: Repeated advice gets named once, kindly, and then closed with a new topic.
